title: Authentication not accepted by the UE

entities.name: EPS authentication procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure where UE verifies network authenticity using AUTN parameter from AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by network containing AUTN parameter for authentication challenge.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE when authentication fails, containing EMM cause indicating failure reason.

entities.name: AUTN parameter
entities.description: Authentication token containing MAC code, AMF field with separation bit, and SQN for network authentication.

entities.name: MAC code failure condition
entities.description: Condition where UE finds MAC code in AUTN parameter to be invalid.

entities.name: Non-EPS authentication unacceptable condition
entities.description: Condition where separation bit in AMF field of AUTN is 0.

entities.name: SQN out of range condition
entities.description: Condition where SQN in AUTN parameter is out of acceptable range.

entities.name: Timer T3416
entities.description: Timer running during authentication procedure that gets stopped when authentication fails.

entities.name: Delete stored RAND and RES
entities.description: UE behavior to delete previously stored RAND and RES values when authentication fails.

relations.description: Authentication procedure involves receiving AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains AUTN parameter.
MAC code failure condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with EMM cause #20.
Non-EPS authentication unacceptable condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with EMM cause #26.
SQN out of range condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with EMM cause #21 and AUTS token.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message triggers deletion of stored RAND and RES.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message stops timer T3416 if running.
AUTN parameter validity is guarded by MAC code verification condition.
AUTN parameter AMF field separation bit guards non-EPS authentication acceptability.
AUTN parameter SQN value guards synchronization condition.
